title: Less Context, Better Agents: Efficient Context Engineering for Long-Horizon Tool-Using LLM Agents
title_zh: 更少上下文，更好 Agent：面向长程工具调用 LLM Agent 的高效上下文工程
abstract_en: Large language models deployed as autonomous agents for enterprise workflows face a key challenge: verbose tool responses from enterprise systems can cause context overflow, stale-state errors, and high inference cost. We study this problem in automated expense itemization in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations using Model Context Protocol tools. We evaluate four GPT-5 configurations on a 50-task hotel expense benchmark: no user model, full conversation history, context pruned to the last 5 tool call/response pairs, and pruning with automated summarization. Results are averaged across 5 independent runs, with the user model held constant for the context-engineering comparison. The no-user-model baseline achieves only 8.0% complete itemization. Full-context retention improves completion to 71.0%, but consumes 1,480,996 tokens and 14.56 hours per benchmark. Pruning to the last 5 tool calls improves completion to 79.0% while reducing token use to 535,274 and runtime to 5.39 hours. Adding summarization achieves the best result: 91.6% complete itemization and 99.64% average amount itemized, with 553,374 tokens and 5.79 hours. We further report confidence intervals, effect-size analysis, sensitivity over pruning and summary windows, failure analysis, results across five expense types grouped into three categories, and cross-model evidence with Claude Sonnet 4.5. These results show that, for this class of enterprise tool-use workflow, selective retention of recent tool interactions plus compact summarization can improve both reliability and efficiency compared with full-history retention.
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业工作流中自主 LLM Agent 面临的上下文管理问题：企业系统返回的工具响应往往冗长，容易导致上下文溢出、状态过期错误和高推理成本。作者以 Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations 中基于 Model Context Protocol tools 的自动差旅费用明细拆分任务为场景，在包含 50 个酒店费用任务的 benchmark 上评估四种 GPT-5 配置：无用户模型、保留完整对话历史、仅保留最近 5 组工具调用/响应、以及在剪枝基础上加入自动摘要。结果显示，无用户模型仅达到 8.0% 完整拆分率；完整上下文提升至 71.0%，但消耗 1,480,996 tokens、耗时 14.56 小时；仅保留最近 5 次工具交互进一步提升至 79.0%，同时将 token 降至 535,274、耗时降至 5.39 小时；剪枝加摘要取得最佳效果，完整拆分率达 91.6%，平均金额拆分率达 99.64%，token 为 553,374、耗时 5.79 小时。论文还报告了置信区间、效应量、剪枝与摘要窗口敏感性、失败案例分析、不同费用类型结果，以及 Claude Sonnet 4.5 的跨模型证据。研究表明，在企业工具调用型长程任务中，选择性保留近期工具交互并结合紧凑摘要，能同时提升可靠性与效率，优于完整历史保留。
key_points_zh: 问题聚焦于企业级长程工具调用 Agent：冗长工具响应会造成上下文膨胀、状态陈旧和推理成本上升。
在 Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations 的酒店费用明细拆分任务中，完整上下文虽提升成功率，但 token 和运行时间开销极高。
仅保留最近 5 组工具调用/响应比完整历史更高效且更可靠，完整拆分率从 71.0% 提升到 79.0%。
剪枝结合自动摘要效果最佳，达到 91.6% 完整拆分率和 99.64% 平均金额拆分率，同时保持较低 token 与时间成本。
跨 GPT-5 配置与 Claude Sonnet 4.5 的实验支持结论：对企业工具使用工作流而言，少量近期上下文加压缩摘要优于全量历史。

llm_assessment.comment: Practical enterprise context-engineering work with strong operational relevance, though its contribution is mainly an empirical pruning-and-summary strategy rather than a general harness architecture.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这项工作对企业级上下文工程很实用，但主要贡献是剪枝与摘要策略的实证验证，而不是通用 harness 架构。
